notes: All dimensions/weights read from GSMArena device pages on 2026-10-20 (apple.com/samsung.com/store.google.com/mi.com not opened). thick_mm is body thickness; camera bump adds extra and GSMArena does not state it, so camera_bump_mm is null. Where a page lists several variants (S24 167/168 g, Xiaomi 14/15 thickness, etc.) the largest value is used. Case allowances are defaults (+1.5mm/side typical silicone/TPU, +3mm/side rugged OtterBox/UAG class); no real measured case dimensions were looked up, so they are unverified assumptions. USB port position is general knowledge, not from the source page; Ultra models have S Pen beside the port.

bulky.note: user-specified bulky silicone/rugged case: ~2-3 mm per side, ~3 mm thickness

rugged.note: stress case, OtterBox/UAG class (assumption, not measured)
